messages:
liz: Quick sync — Galileo (HW + SI) asked for a private-offer + marketplace listing and wants a coordinated joint announcement. Need pricing bands, renewal language, and a PRACTICAL announce window. Who can take lead?
raj: I can draft commit tiers this morning. are we doing monthly commit or annual prepay?
emily: sales needs clear field playbook + incentive to push to commit. prefer annual commit with quarterly true-ups.
sara: SI enablement note — Galileo wants a co-marketing wave aligned with their partner summit (mid-May). timeline is tight. :eyes:
liz: Mid-May works if we lock terms this week. Raj — can you include hw-credit passthrough? Galileo expects a small HW rebate for gold customers.
raj: Sure. Draft tiers below (very rough):
```
Commit bands (USD, 12-mo term):
- Starter: $10k/mo (12m) -> 8% discount, no HW rebate
- Scale: $50k/mo (12m) -> 15% discount + $20k HW rebate pass-through
- Enterprise: $200k/mo (12m) -> 24% discount + $75k HW rebate pass-through + onboarding credits
Optional monthly true-up; billed quarterly.
```
kevin: Heads up from legal: refund windows, export compliance, and data residency opt-ins must be explicit for marketplace listings. Also avoid wording that guarantees HW discounts — we can pass-through at list price but need Galileo MSA to confirm.
emily: Got it. Sales ask: can we include a limited-time enrollment credit for first 90 days to accelerate close? e.g., 10% first-quarter credit.
raj: We can add a one-time enrollment credit. I'll add that to the Scale/Enterprise bands.
sara: SI enablement checklist (quick): joint case study template; Galileo training session (2 hrs); co-sell play doc; demo kit. Need owners.
liz: Assignments: Raj -> pricing + SKU mapping; Emily -> field incentive + one-pager; Sara -> SI enablement plan + runbook; Kevin -> contract language + marketplace T&Cs. I'll coordinate announce timing with Galileo PM.
announce-bot: Draft announce window saved to calendar: Proposed customer-facing announce = 2026-05-18, Partner summit session = 2026-05-20. Please confirm before EOD Friday.
emily: Confirmed from sales side — pipeline pushes could be ready by May 18 if commit terms land this week.
kevin: I'll send redline template by EOD. Quick note: add automatic renewal opt-out with 30-day notice and 90-day price protection post-renewal.
raj: Updated SKU map (rough):
```
- rwd-galileo-starter-v1
- rwd-galileo-scale-v1
- rwd-galileo-enterprise-v1
Marketplace listing: include abbreviated term summary, referral link to private-offer URL, and partner logo tile.
```
liz: One more ask — Galileo wants a co-branded announcement blurb. I'll draft and loop in comms.
sara: For SI integrations, we should bundle a "fast-start" service SKU (2-week engagement) for pilots. That can be sold as add-on or included in Enterprise.
emily: Sales prefers it as add-on to avoid margin squeeze.
kevin: Legal ok with add-on. Ensure SOW limits scope for pilots.
raj: Final action: I'll push a polished pricing doc and private-offer template by 3pm today. Shareable link in thread when ready.
liz: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me @liz. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
